The scoped-permissions test prerequisite had two environment assumptions that stopped its original regressions: filesystem discovery treated Miniflare metadata.sqlite as a second application database, and the broad unit job treated installer-generated working store/cache settings as the original policy fixture. The tests now observe the actual DB binding of their already owned synthetic worker and read the committed policy fixture through bounded git show HEAD:pnpm-workspace.yaml. Actual working configuration hashes remain in the unchanged before/after custody maps.

The native adapter preserves the original four-table/org/order queries, actor/key receipt count, clinical before/after hashes, 403/no-store/privacy/zero-receipt oracles and all eight literal GEO scenarios. Missing/error/null D1 results fail instead of becoming empty rows or zero. The DB binding remains under the original owned worker disposal and query deadlines. The canonical policy selection changes no original callback: all 22 positive/refusal/setup controls remain byte-exact, with 16 MiB/20-second/SIGKILL Git bounds.

The dedicated installer-custody wrapper remains unchanged: run the pinned installer, retain actual generated source/security/profile/lock/installed-identity evidence, require only the declared project store/cache substitutions while every other policy value stays unchanged, restore only exact saved workspace bytes, then run the original full clean-source guard. No application, identity, clinical policy, dependency, installer, severity, acceptance register or original minimum changes. All 374 regression objects and 31 original policy/source pins remain intact.

Current head6100c85b631189568a8128e171d2ffa2cb75cb0a, tree8728c4a590eb098683add1dfe81a1019c7aaf2dc: a copied exact published-source context using the actual saved generated workspace reproduced 21 passing/one failing control. The same context with committed-policy fixture selection passes22/22, zero failed/skipped, while the actual generated working hash stays unchanged. Documentation/1791 source digests,176 requirement audit, catalogue, syntax and whitespace pass. Separate root and child finite reviews verified the exact three-file successor; these are source reviews, not human/domain approval. No installer, build, Worker, browser or native D1 ran locally for this correction.

Preserved actual CI at previous head7b45647e: scoped run38163514372/job114541189405 passed all eight original GEO groups plus five custody checks (13/0/0),63 actual HTTP responses and four denied writes with403/no-store/equal clinical hashes/receipt count zero. Installer restoration,22 custody controls,24 launcher controls and13 malformed-result controls passed; the owned runtime was disposed with no live owned process group. The generated test-merge6b972502 has the exact previous tree9308d497 and is not an actual main merge. Documentation run38163514421 passed. An independent read-only evidence review confirmed the saved source, migration, response and cleanup records; raw built dist files were not uploaded, so independent build verification is limited to recorded hash-map equality. The earlier711 native7/3 database-file setup failure and all raw observations remain preserved.

Actual current-head CI is complete: scoped run 38164860375, documentation run 38164860477 and engineering run 38164860382 all succeeded. Native execution passed all eight unchanged GEO scenarios plus five custody checks (13 passed, zero failed/skipped), 63 actual HTTP responses and four refused writes with 403/no-store, equal clinical hashes and actual receipt count zero. The generated test-merge 2174dabc has exact tree 8728c4a5 and parents main 7668a03d plus head 6100c85b; it is not an actual main merge. All 16,894 recorded source hashes match the immutable checkout, with only the explicitly declared Android CRLF conversion; the 265 recorded dist maps remain stable, but raw dist bytes were not uploaded for another independent rehash. Actual broad unit CI passed 204 suites/10,761 checks, including all 22 canonical policy-fixture controls against unchanged generated working configuration, and the original 201-suite minimum guard. App-first regression CI passed 147 suites/7,691 checks and all 147 original minima, with zero failures/skips or quarantine. The original final smoke/security/UAT selection passed seven suites/190 checks, zero failures, retaining one declared media-route skip because no file was uploaded. Today (58 checks) and HTTP/restore (5,041 checks) also passed. Counts stay separate by phase and are not unique formal acceptance cases. Optional evidence folders retain actual reports, logs, cleanup and failure history for selected review; no source baseline was expanded.

This draft is the existing APL-194 engineering prerequisite under APL-34 / SAHA-011 / BR-ID-02. It remains based on historical main7668a03d and React19.2.6, and does not qualify the separate current routine/security candidate. Current-base integration, full-parent/formal/hosted/physical acceptance and root release gates are separate. No merge, deployment or newly delivered user story is claimed.
